200.html:
data [required]

object

Archive Search object.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes of an Archive Search.

archive_id [required]

string

ID of the archive being searched.

bytes_scanned [required]

int64

Number of bytes read from the archive at the end of the search.

completed_at

date-time

Time the Archive Search finished, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Absent while the search is still running.

created_at [required]

date-time

Time the Archive Search was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

description

string

Free-text description of the Archive Search.

events_scanned [required]

int64

Number of events read from the archive at the end of the search.

expected_duration

int64

Estimated time left before the Archive Search completes, in seconds.

from [required]

date-time

Start of the searched time range, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

name [required]

string

Name of the Archive Search.

query [required]

string

Log search query used to filter the archived logs.

rehydration

object

Rehydration settings of the Archive Search. Absent when the search only scans the archive without indexing the results.

max_rehydrated_events [required]

int64

Maximum number of events to rehydrate.

retention_days [required]

int64

Number of days the rehydrated logs are retained for.

tier [required]

enum

Storage tier the matched logs are rehydrated into. Allowed enum values: standard,flex

status [required]

enum

Current state of an Archive Search. Allowed enum values: RUNNING,COMPLETED,FAILED,CANCELLED,QUOTA_REACHED,EXPIRED

to [required]

date-time

End of the searched time range, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the Archive Search.

type [required]

enum

Archive Search resource type. Allowed enum values: archive_search

default: archive_search

request.html:
data [required]

object

Archive Search object to create.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes accepted when creating an Archive Search.

archive_id [required]

string

ID of the archive to search. Use the Logs Archives API to list the archives of the organization.

description

string

Free-text description of the Archive Search.

from [required]

date-time

Start of the time range to search, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

name [required]

string

Name of the Archive Search.

query [required]

string

Log search query used to filter the archived logs.

rehydration

object

Rehydration settings. Include this object to index the matched logs into a retained historical view. Omit it to run an Archive Search that only scans the archive.

max_rehydrated_events [required]

int64

Maximum number of events to rehydrate. The organization's reindexing limit is configured in millions, so this value is at least 1,000,000.

retention_days [required]

int64

Number of days the rehydrated logs are retained for.

tier [required]

enum

Storage tier the matched logs are rehydrated into. Allowed enum values: standard,flex

to [required]

date-time

End of the time range to search, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Must be after from.

type [required]

enum

Archive Search resource type. Allowed enum values: archive_search

default: archive_search
